# Instructions for accurately documenting failed advertised specifications in a consumer product performance report

1. Start with the test records.
2.
completion:
3. Record the exact listing, ordering, and wording of the failed specifications.
4. Record the test identifier.
5. Record the manufacturer name.
6. Record the model number.
7. Record the facility specific serial number.
8. Record the manufacturing location.
9. Record the date of manufacture.
10. Record the test results.
11. Include the traceability of any third party qualification results.
12. Record the test methodology used.

This procedure is only applicable to the documentation of failed advertised specifications in a consumer product performance report.
